rule: Code bodies are published only on proof of a licence or permission applicable to the codes. A repository licence of a compiler does not by itself establish the authority of third-party code authors (docs/licenses/cheats/README.md).

verdicts.licence-verified: licence checked against the published content
verdicts.licence-declared: the code author or data licence grants redistribution
verdicts.compiler-licence: a licence of the compiling repository; third-party authors not established
verdicts.tooling-licence-only: licence covers scripts or tools, not the codes
verdicts.no-licence-evidence: no licence or written permission recorded
